info.name: Student CRUD API
info.description: Contract-driven suite; schemas generated from OpenAPI.

exec: (()=>{const id='TC30';pm.test(id+': HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));try { const s=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('openapi_HealthResponse')||'{}'); pm.test('schema: OpenAPI HealthResponse',()=>pm.expect(tv4.validate(pm.response.json(),s),JSON.stringify(tv4.error)).to.eql(true)); } catch(e) { pm.test('schema: OpenAPI HealthResponse',()=>{throw e;}); }pm.test('TC30: status is ok',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('ok'));})();
pm.variables.set('base_url', pm.environment.get('base_url') || 'http://localhost:5000');
if (!pm.environment.get('run_id')) pm.environment.set('run_id', Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7));
if (!pm.environment.get('test_email')) pm.environment.set('test_email','run'+pm.environment.get('run_id')+'@example.com');
if (!pm.environment.get('unique_course')) pm.environment.set('unique_course','Q'+pm.environment.get('run_id').slice(-10));

(()=>{const id='TC01';pm.test(id+': HTTP 201',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(201));try { const s=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('openapi_StudentResponse')||'{}'); pm.test('schema: OpenAPI StudentResponse',()=>pm.expect(tv4.validate(pm.response.json(),s),JSON.stringify(tv4.error)).to.eql(true)); } catch(e) { pm.test('schema: OpenAPI StudentResponse',()=>{throw e;}); }const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.environment.set('student_id',d.id);pm.environment.set('created_at',d.createdAt);pm.environment.set('updated_at',d.updatedAt);pm.test('TC01: id is 24 lowercase hex',()=>pm.expect(d.id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{24}$/));pm.test('TC01: email normalized',()=>pm.expect(d.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('test_email').toLowerCase()));pm.test('TC01: success true',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(true));})();
